sloka: सत्येनाहं शपे राजन्स्वर्गलोके न चैव हि ।न कामये यथा राज्यं त्वां विना रघुनन्दन ।। ७.१०७.६ ॥
transliteration: satyenāhaṁ śape rājansvargaloke na caiva hi ।na kāmaye yathā rājyaṁ tvāṁ vinā raghunandana ।। 7.107.6 ॥

translations.english: O King, I swear by truth, and indeed by the heavenly world, that I do not desire kingship without you, O delight of the Raghus.
